mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.check_id, i.material_id, i.location_id, i.batch_no, i.book_qty, i.actual_qty, i.serial_nos, i.remark, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.batch_enabled, m.serial_enabled, l.code AS location_code FROM wms_check_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id WHERE i.check_id = #{checkId} ORDER BY i.id
